en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a low stone fortification or earthwork with rifle slits along the walls. A ramped dirt road leads down through a masonry archway in the center. Several people, likely soldiers or travelers, stand on the top of the wall and near the arch, dressed in early-20th‑century style. The landscape around is open and slightly hilly, with no prominent buildings in the background. A small manuscript number appears in the upper-left corner.
